title: Easy Canadian Pork Chops
description: A simple and delicious pork chop recipe from Canada, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of pork, garlic, and herbs creates a mouthwatering dish that's sure to please.
instructions: Season the pork chops with thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the pork chops to a baking sheet and brush with maple syrup.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Let the pork chops rest for 5 minutes before serving.
